column7: migrate-provider RestoreBackup rewrote the active wrapped DEK in place (O_TRUNC then write), so a crash or a failed write during the rollback left a torn dek.key (REVIEW-ENCRYPTIONOPS-1 R1); it now writes <backup>.restoring and renames it over the DEK. TestRestoreBackup_FailedWriteLeavesTheActiveDEKIntact (darwin) is the behavioural red on the old code.
